offerings.name: Phase 1 Workshop
offerings.description: The foundational workshop that focuses on understanding the philosophy and core principles behind racism — a historical, cultural, structural, and institutional analysis. Phase 1 builds a shared language and a systems-level framework for understanding how racial inequity is produced and maintained, independent of individual intention.
offerings.audience: Organizations and individuals; minimum 15 / maximum 35 participants (firm)
offerings.bookingNote: Bring Phase 1 to your organization through REI's booking portal. Booking requests are confirmed or declined within 10 business days. Workbooks are included.

offerings.name: Phase 2 Workshop
offerings.tagline: From personal experience to institutional outcomes
offerings.description: Deepens the Phase 1 analysis, shifting the focus from personal experience to institutional outcomes — from an individual lens to a systems analysis. Phase 2 helps organizations apply the foundational framework to the concrete patterns and outcomes inside their own institutions.
offerings.bookingNote: Open to Phase 1 graduates. Book through REI's booking portal.

offerings.name: The Groundwater Approach
offerings.tagline: Understanding Racial Inequity — REI's signature presentation
offerings.description: An interactive presentation on the nature and impact of structural racism. Data-driven and cross-system: if you find dead fish in one lake, you ask about the fish; if you find dead fish in every lake, you analyze the groundwater. The Groundwater Approach uses disparities data from across systems — education, health, housing, justice — to show that racial inequity is structural, not anecdotal.
offerings.bookingNote: The free Groundwater whitepaper by Bayard Love and Deena Hayes-Greene is available from REI's resources page.

offerings.name: REI Pre-Brief
offerings.tagline: Get ready for the depth and pace of Phase 1
offerings.description: A 60-minute introductory session preparing participants for the depth, pace, and transformative learning of the Phase 1 workshop.
offerings.bookingNote: Book alongside a Phase 1 workshop through REI's booking portal.

offerings.name: REI Debrief
offerings.tagline: Connect the concepts to your organization's work
offerings.description: Reviews workshop concepts, paying attention to how they relate to each other and to your organization's work. A structured space for teams to process and apply what they learned.
offerings.audience: Groundwater and Phase 1/2 alumni; maximum 35 participants
offerings.bookingNote: For organizations that have completed a Groundwater session or Phase 1/2 workshop.

offerings.name: Latinx/Latino Challenges
offerings.tagline: A critical analysis for and about Latino communities
offerings.description: A two-day workshop for people who live in or work with Latino communities — a critical analysis of how racism disempowers Latinos, and what it takes to organize against it.
offerings.audience: People living in or working with Latino communities

offerings.name: Measuring Racial Equity: Asian Americans
offerings.description: A three-hour data-disaggregation presentation on the often overlooked impacts of racism on Asian American communities.

offerings.name: Education Module 1: Mindsets, Maps & Margins
offerings.tagline: How bias, school zones, and resource patterns shape student outcomes
offerings.description: How Bias, School Zones, and Resource Patterns Shape Student Outcomes — the first module in REI's education series for educators.
offerings.bookingNote: Part of REI's education series. Contact REI to bring it to your school or district.

offerings.name: Education Module 2: How Systems Shape Thinking
offerings.tagline: The neuroscience of bias meets the geography of education disparity
offerings.description: The Neuroscience of Bias Meets the Geography of Education Disparity — the second module in REI's education series, for educators and school leaders.
offerings.bookingNote: Part of REI's education series. Contact REI to bring it to your school or district.

offerings.name: Education Module 3: Seeing the Unseen in Our Schools
offerings.description: Patterns, Poverty & Perception — structural inequity for educators; the third module in REI's education series for educators and system leaders.
offerings.bookingNote: Part of REI's education series. Contact REI to bring it to your school or district.

offerings.name: Youth Workshop
offerings.tagline: Racial Equity Leadership Institute for Youth
offerings.description: A two-day, video- and exercise-heavy version of REI's foundational training designed for high school students.

offerings.name: Consulting
offerings.description: Available only to organizations that have completed REI training, typically after Phase 2. REI consults with alumni organizations on applying the analysis to institutional change with equitable and just outcomes.
offerings.bookingNote: Contact REI to discuss a consulting engagement.

offerings.name: Equity Paradox Conference
offerings.tagline: REI's annual conference — equity alone is not the remedy for inequity
offerings.description: REI's annual three-day conference in Greensboro, NC. Day 1: Groundwater Institute with a Fish Lake/neuroscience opening. Day 2: application and cross-systems work. Day 3: community power and a closing luncheon. Cross-sector audience; lodging block at the Proximity Hotel.
